text.en:
Any provision of the Tariff and Customs Code and all other laws to the contrary
notwithstanding, the Sterling Philippine Airways, Inc. is hereby authorized to pay a two percent (2%)
franchise tax in lieu of all taxes, including compensating and duty taxes for its importation of equipment,
fuels, lubricants, spare parts and accessories necessary for its operations.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 12th day of April, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-seven.
